chunks: Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā, from al-Sindī ibn Muḥammad, from Yūnus ibn Yaʿqūb, from ʿAbd al-Aʿlā ibn Aʿyan, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about the urine of donkeys and mules, so he said: “Wash your garment.”
He said: I said, “Then what about their dung?” He said: “It is more than that.”

key_terms.أَبْوَالِ: urine; here, the urine of donkeys and mules
key_terms.هُوَ أَكْثَرُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ: it is more than that; indicating extension of the ruling

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام say about urine and dung of donkeys and mules on clothing?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal ruling from Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام concerning the impurity affecting clothing from donkeys and mules. It indicates that when a garment is affected by their urine, it should be washed, and it extends the ruling to their dung as well.
